Architectural Designer | Residential | Remote in Greater Boston | 20–40 hours per week
FRANK architecture + design is a small architecture practice based in Quincy, Massachusetts. We’re looking for an architectural designer to help with residential projects across Greater Boston, including additions, renovations, ADUs, new homes, and some smaller commercial projects!
This is a remote role with local site work. You’ll do your drafting and modeling remotely, but you’ll need to be within commuting distance of Quincy and available for in-person site meetings, field measurements, and documentation of existing conditions at project sites around Greater Boston.
What you’ll do
Join site visits to measure and document existing conditions.
Draft existing and proposed plans, elevations, sections, and details in AutoCAD.
Build and revise SketchUp models to explore design options and present them to clients.
Incorporate redlines and help assemble permit and construction drawing sets.
What we’re looking for
At least 2-3 years of professional experience and
Proficiency in AutoCAD and working knowledge of SketchUp.
Experience drafting architectural drawings. Residential renovation or permit set experience is a plus.
Attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.
Schedule and compensation
We anticipate 20–40 hours per week, depending on workload and availability. We’ll agree on a consistent weekly schedule that accommodates project deadlines and site visits. Compensation is hourly and based on experience.
How to apply
Email Elliott at [email protected] with a brief introduction, your résumé, and a few work samples. If available, include an architectural drawing set or excerpt and tell us which sheets you personally drafted. Please also share your weekly availability and your availability for local site visits.
